fluff.overview: Lyran military budgets translate directly into infantry equipment quality, giving LCAF conventional forces a material edge that compensates for the uneven tactical leadership the social general tradition sometimes produces. Mechanized tracked platoons deploy from armored personnel carriers that provide protection during movement and allow the formation to keep pace with heavier combat vehicles in offensive operations. Equipped with Maxell PL-10 laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the more effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
